description: Election Commission - Declare that Munidasa Kandambige was selected as the member of the Pitabeddara P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Pitabeddara Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a resignation and the subsequent nomination by a political party, which falls under electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
